selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of bilateral punctate superficial keratitis, stromal immune ring formation, and keratic precipitates, along with the positive IgM CHIKV serologic test and aqueous tap PCR results positive for Chikungunya virus, best supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: Lack of heterochromia and absence of characteristic findings

rejected.label: Immune-mediated keratitis
rejected.why: Too broad and nonspecific, given the specific viral findings

rejected.label: Stromal keratitis
rejected.why: Too nonspecific, as it does not account for the full spectrum of the patient's presentation and the specific viral etiology

rejected.label: Chikungunya virus infection
rejected.why: While the patient has a Chikungunya virus infection, this option does not specifically address the ocular manifestations
